claims.text: NCEL outperforms all baseline methods in both easy and hard cases, indicating its overall effectiveness.
NCEL consistently shows favorable generalization ability across five public benchmarks, further supporting its effectiveness.
The efficiency of NCEL is verified through theoretical comparisons of time complexity with other collective alternatives, suggesting it is not only effective but also efficient.
